Five genuine coverage gaps were closed to get there, each found by measuring rather than assuming: (1) profile units - the synthetic fixture declared price_scale=1000 while the genuine stream carries 1000000, now derived via factory.instruments.declared_tick_profile(); (2) timestamp precision - a hardcoded whole-second quantum flagged 124,125 millisecond rows as structural issues, now derived from the observed source_precision; (3) calendar coverage - a 24/7 fixture cannot classify real weekend gaps, now a declared session for the sampled instrument; (4) instrument identity - a mixed-instrument sample could never satisfy a per-instrument calendar or profile, now sampled from one instrument with the strategy instrument and strategy_hash recomputed; (5) idempotency - independent_evaluation recorded an evaluation-with-past-only-warmup use for the sampled window, which discovery then treated as an excluded interval, so a second run failed its own diagnose stage. The rehearsal now refuses a state root it would pollute. The declared session remains a TEST_ONLY rehearsal assumption, not verified broker metadata, so the ADR0051 profile registry work remains open. Only the import stage remains unrun, and it is blocked on the quarantine correction policy.
